metadata.method: Independent Decimal(precision=60) + zoneinfo reference. For every prefix it recomputes mu = sum(P*V)/sum(V) and sigma = sqrt(sum(V*(P-mu)^2)/sum(V)) over all valid bars from the anchor. No Welford, no recurrence, no TypeScript logic. Anchor indices are resolved independently with datetime/zoneinfo.
metadata.tolerance: 1e-9 relative for vwap, stdDev, cumVolume and all bands; exact for anchorIndex and time
metadata.nanEncoding: NaN se serializa como la cadena "NaN"
